# ---- Master/Sites combined grid builder — inline runPrepQuery ----
	# RULE #2: NOT SITE-SCOPED. Admin manages ALL sites -> NO site filter, every row.
	# IG81-COMPAT: plain parameterized T-SQL; identical on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	parts = unicode(value).split("|")
	searchTerm = parts[0]

	sql = ("SELECT  IN_SITE_ID              AS RecordID, "
	       "        VC_SITE_ABBR            AS Abbr, "
	       "        VC_SITE_NAME            AS SiteName, "
	       "        VC_STATE                AS State, "
	       "        VC_DUNS                 AS DUNS, "
	       "        VC_FORECAST_IMPORT_MODE AS FCMode "
	       "FROM    INV_SITES "
	       "WHERE  (? = '' OR VC_SITE_ABBR LIKE '%' + ? + '%' OR VC_SITE_NAME LIKE '%' + ? + '%' OR VC_DUNS LIKE '%' + ? + '%') "
	       "ORDER BY VC_SITE_ABBR")   # RULE #2: deliberately NO site_id predicate
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(sql, [searchTerm, searchTerm, searchTerm, searchTerm], DB)
	log.info("SPIKE Sites/list: %d rows (search='%s')" % (ds.rowCount, searchTerm))

	columns = [
		{"field": "Abbr",     "header": {"title": "Abbr"}, "strictWidth": 90, "sort": "ascending"},
		{"field": "SiteName", "header": {"title": "Site Name"}},
		{"field": "State",    "header": {"title": "State"}, "strictWidth": 70},
		{"field": "DUNS",     "header": {"title": "DUNS"}, "strictWidth": 120},
		{"field": "FCMode",   "header": {"title": "FC Mode"}, "strictWidth": 90},
		{"field": "RecordID", "header": {"title": "id"}, "visible": False}
	]
	rows = []
	for r in xrange(ds.rowCount):
		rows.append({
			"RecordID": ds.getValueAt(r, "RecordID"),
			"Abbr":     ds.getValueAt(r, "Abbr"),
			"SiteName": ds.getValueAt(r, "SiteName"),
			"State":    ds.getValueAt(r, "State"),
			"DUNS":     ds.getValueAt(r, "DUNS"),
			"FCMode":   ds.getValueAt(r, "FCMode")
		})
	return {"data": rows, "columns": columns}

onChange.script:
# ---- Sites combined view: recordId change -> load detail ----
	# Grid onRowClick sets self.view.custom.recordId (same-view prop write, NO
	# navigation). recordId==0 -> insert mode. RULE #2: get is NOT site-scoped.
	# IG81-COMPAT: plain change script + T-SQL.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	v = self.view if hasattr(self, "view") else self
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = v.custom
	cv = getattr(currentValue, "value", currentValue)
	recId = int(cv or 0)
	log.info("SPIKE Sites Detail recordId onChange fired: recId=%s origin=%s" % (recId, origin))
	if recId <= 0:
		c.statusMsg = "New site — enter details and Save."
		log.info("SPIKE Sites Detail: insert mode (recordId=0)")
		return
	getSql = ("SELECT IN_SITE_ID, VC_SITE_NAME, VC_SITE_ABBR, VC_STREET, VC_CITY, VC_STATE, VC_COUNTRY, VC_ZIP, VC_DUNS, VC_SUPPLIER_CODE, VC_DOCK_CODE, IN_EIN_SEQ, VC_EDI_MODE, VC_SEP_SEGMENT, VC_SEP_ELEMENT, VC_SEP_SUBELEMENT, VC_TMM_NAME, VC_TMM_ABBR, VC_TMM_DUNS, IN_MAX_SEQUENCE, BIT_ACCEPT_ANY_ORDER_ASN, VC_DELIVERY_METHOD_CODE, IN_FILL_DAYS, IN_FORECAST_USAGE_COMPARE, BIT_USE_FIRST_PRODUCTION_DAY, VC_FORECAST_IMPORT_MODE, VC_LAST_FORECAST_IMPORT, BIT_ENABLE_DATA_PURGE, BIT_PROMPT_DATA_PURGE, IN_DATA_RETENTION, VC_EDIOUT_DIR, VC_EDIIN_DIR, VC_FORECAST_DIR, VC_LOGISTICS_DIR, VC_REPORTS_DIR, VC_SHIPPING_DIR, VC_TEMPLATE_DIR, VC_LAST_UPDATE, VC_ADD FROM INV_SITES WHERE IN_SITE_ID = ?")  # RULE #2: no site predicate
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(getSql, [recId], DB)
	if ds.rowCount == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Site id %d not found." % recId
		log.warn("SPIKE Sites Detail: id %d not found" % recId); return
	def g(col):
		val = ds.getValueAt(0, col)
		return val if val is not None else ""
	_v = ds.getValueAt(0, "IN_SITE_ID")
	c.form_id = int(_v) if _v is not None else 0
	c.form_name = g("VC_SITE_NAME")
	c.form_abbr = g("VC_SITE_ABBR")
	c.form_street = g("VC_STREET")
	c.form_city = g("VC_CITY")
	c.form_state = g("VC_STATE")
	c.form_country = g("VC_COUNTRY")
	c.form_zip = g("VC_ZIP")
	c.form_duns = g("VC_DUNS")
	c.form_supcode = g("VC_SUPPLIER_CODE")
	c.form_dock = g("VC_DOCK_CODE")
	_v = ds.getValueAt(0, "IN_EIN_SEQ")
	c.form_einseq = int(_v) if _v is not None else 0
	c.form_edimode = g("VC_EDI_MODE")
	c.form_sepseg = g("VC_SEP_SEGMENT")
	c.form_sepelem = g("VC_SEP_ELEMENT")
	c.form_sepsub = g("VC_SEP_SUBELEMENT")
	c.form_tmmname = g("VC_TMM_NAME")
	c.form_tmmabbr = g("VC_TMM_ABBR")
	c.form_tmmduns = g("VC_TMM_DUNS")
	_v = ds.getValueAt(0, "IN_MAX_SEQUENCE")
	c.form_maxseq = int(_v) if _v is not None else 0
	c.form_acceptasn = 1 if (g("BIT_ACCEPT_ANY_ORDER_ASN") in (1, True, "1")) else 0
	c.form_delivery = g("VC_DELIVERY_METHOD_CODE")
	_v = ds.getValueAt(0, "IN_FILL_DAYS")
	c.form_filldays = int(_v) if _v is not None else 0
	_v = ds.getValueAt(0, "IN_FORECAST_USAGE_COMPARE")
	c.form_fcusage = int(_v) if _v is not None else 0
	c.form_usefpd = 1 if (g("BIT_USE_FIRST_PRODUCTION_DAY") in (1, True, "1")) else 0
	c.form_fcmode = g("VC_FORECAST_IMPORT_MODE")
	c.form_lastfc = g("VC_LAST_FORECAST_IMPORT")
	c.form_enpurge = 1 if (g("BIT_ENABLE_DATA_PURGE") in (1, True, "1")) else 0
	c.form_prpurge = 1 if (g("BIT_PROMPT_DATA_PURGE") in (1, True, "1")) else 0
	_v = ds.getValueAt(0, "IN_DATA_RETENTION")
	c.form_retention = int(_v) if _v is not None else 0
	c.form_ediout = g("VC_EDIOUT_DIR")
	c.form_ediin = g("VC_EDIIN_DIR")
	c.form_forecastd = g("VC_FORECAST_DIR")
	c.form_logisticsd = g("VC_LOGISTICS_DIR")
	c.form_reportsd = g("VC_REPORTS_DIR")
	c.form_shippingd = g("VC_SHIPPING_DIR")
	c.form_templated = g("VC_TEMPLATE_DIR")
	c.form_lastupd = g("VC_LAST_UPDATE")
	c.form_add = g("VC_ADD")
	c.statusMsg = "Editing site %s (id %d)." % (c.form_abbr, recId)
	log.info("SPIKE Sites Detail loaded id=%d abbr=%s name=%s" % (recId, c.form_abbr, c.form_name))

config.script:
# ---- Sites Save (insert-or-update) ----
	# recordId==0 -> insert (IDENTITY assigns id, VC_ADD stamped); >0 -> update
	# (VC_LAST_UPDATE stamped). RULE #3: IN_SITE_ID/IN_EIN_SEQ/VC_LAST_FORECAST_IMPORT
	# are NEVER written by the form. RULE #2: no site predicate.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	# Admin-gate (rule #1, defense-in-depth):
	if not c.isAdmin:
		c.statusMsg = "Admin only — you do not have permission to save sites."
		log.info("SPIKE Sites save BLOCKED: not admin"); return
	def _str(v):
		s = (unicode(v) if v is not None else u"").strip()
		return s
	def _int(v):
		try:
			return int(v) if v not in (None, "") else 0
		except Exception:
			return 0
	def _intn(v):
		# nullable "unset" INT: blank/0 -> None (binds SQL NULL), else the typed int.
		# 0 is NOT a valid stored value for these cols (CK rejects retention 0; the
		# others use NULL as the legacy "unset" marker) -> coerce blank/0 to NULL.
		n = _int(v)
		return n if n != 0 else None
	def _bit(v):
		return 1 if v in (1, True, "1", "true", "True") else 0
	def _mode(v):
		m = (_str(v) or "AUTO").upper()
		return m if m in ("AUTO", "MANUAL") else "AUTO"
	name = _str(c.form_name)
	abbr = _str(c.form_abbr)
	# ---- validation (client-side fast-fail; CHECK constraints are the backstop) ----
	if name == "":
		c.statusMsg = "Site name is required."
		log.info("SPIKE Sites save REJECTED: blank name"); return
	if abbr == "":
		c.statusMsg = "Site abbr is required."
		log.info("SPIKE Sites save REJECTED: blank abbr"); return
	if len(abbr) > 10:
		c.statusMsg = "Site abbr must be 10 characters or fewer."
		log.info("SPIKE Sites save REJECTED: abbr len=%d" % len(abbr)); return
	fillDays = _int(c.form_filldays)
	if fillDays > 50:
		c.statusMsg = "Fill Days must be 50 or fewer (CK_INV_SITES_FILL_DAYS)."
		log.info("SPIKE Sites save REJECTED: fillDays=%d > 50" % fillDays); return
	# Retention: blank/0 = "unset" -> stored as NULL (allowed by the CHECK); a
	# TYPED value 1..11 is invalid and must be rejected with the clear message.
	retention = _int(c.form_retention)
	if retention != 0 and retention < 12:
		c.statusMsg = "Data Retention must be >= 12 months, or left blank/0 for 'unset' (CK_INV_SITES_DATA_RETENTION)."
		log.info("SPIKE Sites save REJECTED: retention=%d (typed 1..11 invalid)" % retention); return
	mode = _mode(c.form_fcmode)
	if mode not in ("AUTO", "MANUAL"):
		c.statusMsg = "Forecast Import Mode must be AUTO or MANUAL."
		log.info("SPIKE Sites save REJECTED: bad mode=%s" % mode); return
	# ---- LOAD-BEARING positional-ISA validation (source-truth §4) ----
	# VC_EDI_MODE -> ISA15 verbatim; the 3 separators are ISA/GS structural
	# chars. A 2+ char value emits a MALFORMED positional ISA (EDI856/810Object).
	# Each must be EXACTLY 1 char if set. Blank is allowed (col is NULLable).
	edimode = _str(c.form_edimode)
	if edimode != "" and len(edimode) != 1:
		c.statusMsg = "EDI Mode must be exactly 1 character (positional ISA15, e.g. 'P' or 'T')."
		log.info("SPIKE Sites save REJECTED: edimode len=%d" % len(edimode)); return
	for _lbl, _v in (("Segment", _str(c.form_sepseg)), ("Element", _str(c.form_sepelem)), ("Sub-element", _str(c.form_sepsub))):
		if _v != "" and len(_v) != 1:
			c.statusMsg = "Separator (%s) must be exactly 1 character (ISA/GS structural)." % _lbl
			log.info("SPIKE Sites save REJECTED: sep %s len=%d" % (_lbl, len(_v))); return
	# DUNS format: 9 digits (or 9+4 = 13 digits), if set. (Real DUNS load at cutover;
	# the spike seed uses 9-digit placeholders.)
	def _duns_ok(d):
		return d == "" or (d.isdigit() and len(d) in (9, 13))
	duns = _str(c.form_duns)
	if not _duns_ok(duns):
		c.statusMsg = "DUNS must be 9 digits (or 9+4 = 13 digits)."
		log.info("SPIKE Sites save REJECTED: bad DUNS=%r" % duns); return
	tmmduns = _str(c.form_tmmduns)
	if not _duns_ok(tmmduns):
		c.statusMsg = "TMM DUNS must be 9 digits (or 9+4 = 13 digits)."
		log.info("SPIKE Sites save REJECTED: bad TMM DUNS=%r" % tmmduns); return
	try:
		if recId == 0:
			insSql = ("INSERT INTO INV_SITES (VC_SITE_NAME, VC_SITE_ABBR, VC_STREET, VC_CITY, VC_STATE, VC_COUNTRY, VC_ZIP, VC_DUNS, VC_SUPPLIER_CODE, VC_DOCK_CODE, IN_EIN_SEQ, VC_EDI_MODE, VC_SEP_SEGMENT, VC_SEP_ELEMENT, VC_SEP_SUBELEMENT, VC_TMM_NAME, VC_TMM_ABBR, VC_TMM_DUNS, IN_MAX_SEQUENCE, BIT_ACCEPT_ANY_ORDER_ASN, VC_DELIVERY_METHOD_CODE, IN_FILL_DAYS, IN_FORECAST_USAGE_COMPARE, BIT_USE_FIRST_PRODUCTION_DAY, VC_FORECAST_IMPORT_MODE, BIT_ENABLE_DATA_PURGE, BIT_PROMPT_DATA_PURGE, IN_DATA_RETENTION, VC_EDIOUT_DIR, VC_EDIIN_DIR, VC_FORECAST_DIR, VC_LOGISTICS_DIR, VC_REPORTS_DIR, VC_SHIPPING_DIR, VC_TEMPLATE_DIR, VC_ADD) "
			          "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?, ?,?,?, 0, ?, ?,?,?, ?,?,?,?, ?,?, ?, ?,?,?, ?,?,?, ?,?,?,?, ?,?,?, CONVERT(char(8),GETDATE(),112) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),1,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),4,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),7,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),10,2)); "
			          "SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS int) AS newId")
			rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(insSql, [_str(c.form_name), _str(c.form_abbr), _str(c.form_street), _str(c.form_city), _str(c.form_state), _str(c.form_country), _str(c.form_zip), _str(c.form_duns), _str(c.form_supcode), _str(c.form_dock), _str(c.form_edimode), _str(c.form_sepseg), _str(c.form_sepelem), _str(c.form_sepsub), _str(c.form_tmmname), _str(c.form_tmmabbr), _str(c.form_tmmduns), _intn(c.form_maxseq), _bit(c.form_acceptasn), _str(c.form_delivery), _intn(c.form_filldays), _intn(c.form_fcusage), _bit(c.form_usefpd), _mode(c.form_fcmode), _bit(c.form_enpurge), _bit(c.form_prpurge), _intn(c.form_retention), _str(c.form_ediout), _str(c.form_ediin), _str(c.form_forecastd), _str(c.form_logisticsd), _str(c.form_reportsd), _str(c.form_shippingd), _str(c.form_templated)], DB)
			newId = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
			c.statusMsg = "Inserted site %s (id %d)." % (abbr, newId)
			log.info("SPIKE Sites INSERT ok: abbr=%s newId=%d" % (abbr, newId))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1
			c.recordId = newId
		else:
			updSql = ("UPDATE INV_SITES SET VC_SITE_NAME=?, VC_SITE_ABBR=?, VC_STREET=?, VC_CITY=?, VC_STATE=?, VC_COUNTRY=?, VC_ZIP=?, VC_DUNS=?, VC_SUPPLIER_CODE=?, VC_DOCK_CODE=?, VC_EDI_MODE=?, VC_SEP_SEGMENT=?, VC_SEP_ELEMENT=?, VC_SEP_SUBELEMENT=?, VC_TMM_NAME=?, VC_TMM_ABBR=?, VC_TMM_DUNS=?, IN_MAX_SEQUENCE=?, BIT_ACCEPT_ANY_ORDER_ASN=?, VC_DELIVERY_METHOD_CODE=?, IN_FILL_DAYS=?, IN_FORECAST_USAGE_COMPARE=?, BIT_USE_FIRST_PRODUCTION_DAY=?, VC_FORECAST_IMPORT_MODE=?, BIT_ENABLE_DATA_PURGE=?, BIT_PROMPT_DATA_PURGE=?, IN_DATA_RETENTION=?, VC_EDIOUT_DIR=?, VC_EDIIN_DIR=?, VC_FORECAST_DIR=?, VC_LOGISTICS_DIR=?, VC_REPORTS_DIR=?, VC_SHIPPING_DIR=?, VC_TEMPLATE_DIR=?, VC_LAST_UPDATE = CONVERT(char(8),GETDATE(),112) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),1,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),4,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),7,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),10,2) "
			          "WHERE IN_SITE_ID = ?")  # RULE #2: no site predicate
			n = system.db.runPrepUpdate(updSql, [_str(c.form_name), _str(c.form_abbr), _str(c.form_street), _str(c.form_city), _str(c.form_state), _str(c.form_country), _str(c.form_zip), _str(c.form_duns), _str(c.form_supcode), _str(c.form_dock), _str(c.form_edimode), _str(c.form_sepseg), _str(c.form_sepelem), _str(c.form_sepsub), _str(c.form_tmmname), _str(c.form_tmmabbr), _str(c.form_tmmduns), _intn(c.form_maxseq), _bit(c.form_acceptasn), _str(c.form_delivery), _intn(c.form_filldays), _intn(c.form_fcusage), _bit(c.form_usefpd), _mode(c.form_fcmode), _bit(c.form_enpurge), _bit(c.form_prpurge), _intn(c.form_retention), _str(c.form_ediout), _str(c.form_ediin), _str(c.form_forecastd), _str(c.form_logisticsd), _str(c.form_reportsd), _str(c.form_shippingd), _str(c.form_templated), recId], DB)
			c.statusMsg = "Updated site %s (%d row)." % (abbr, n)
			log.info("SPIKE Sites UPDATE ok: id=%d abbr=%s rows=%d" % (recId, abbr, n))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1
	except Exception, e:
		c.statusMsg = "Save failed: %s" % unicode(e)
		log.warn("SPIKE Sites save FAILED: %s" % unicode(e))

# ---- Sites Delete — RESTRICT gate (rule #6) ----
	# refCount counts the THROWAWAY INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST.site_id (no FK yet).
	# ⚠️ MUST be EXTENDED to every IN_SITE_ID child once M4 wires the FKs.
	# Block on any non-zero total; never delete a referenced site.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	abbr = (unicode(c.form_abbr) if c.form_abbr is not None else u"").strip()
	if not c.isAdmin:
		c.statusMsg = "Admin only — you do not have permission to delete sites."
		log.info("SPIKE Sites DELETE BLOCKED: not admin"); return
	if recId == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Nothing to delete (unsaved new record)."
		return
	refSql = "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST WHERE site_id = ?) AS n"
	rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(refSql, [recId], DB)
	n = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
	log.info("SPIKE Sites refCount: id=%d abbr=%s n=%d" % (recId, abbr, n))
	if n > 0:
		c.statusMsg = ("Cannot delete site %s — still referenced by %d part(s). "
		               "Reassign or archive those rows first.") % (abbr, n)
		log.info("SPIKE Sites DELETE BLOCKED: id=%d abbr=%s refs=%d" % (recId, abbr, n)); return
	try:
		delN = system.db.runPrepUpdate("DELETE FROM INV_SITES WHERE IN_SITE_ID = ?", [recId], DB)
		log.info("SPIKE Sites DELETE ok: id=%d abbr=%s rows=%d" % (recId, abbr, delN))
		c.statusMsg = "Deleted site %s." % abbr
		c.form_name = ""
		c.form_abbr = ""
		c.form_street = ""
		c.form_city = ""
		c.form_state = ""
		c.form_country = ""
		c.form_zip = ""
		c.form_duns = ""
		c.form_supcode = ""
		c.form_dock = ""
		c.form_edimode = ""
		c.form_sepseg = ""
		c.form_sepelem = ""
		c.form_sepsub = ""
		c.form_tmmname = ""
		c.form_tmmabbr = ""
		c.form_tmmduns = ""
		c.form_maxseq = 0
		c.form_acceptasn = 0
		c.form_delivery = ""
		c.form_filldays = 0
		c.form_fcusage = 0
		c.form_usefpd = 0
		c.form_fcmode = 'AUTO'
		c.form_enpurge = 0
		c.form_prpurge = 1
		c.form_retention = 0
		c.form_ediout = ""
		c.form_ediin = ""
		c.form_forecastd = ""
		c.form_logisticsd = ""
		c.form_reportsd = ""
		c.form_shippingd = ""
		c.form_templated = ""
		c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1
		c.recordId = 0
	except Exception, e:
		c.statusMsg = "Delete failed: %s" % unicode(e)
		log.warn("SPIKE Sites DELETE FAILED: %s" % unicode(e))

c = self.view.custom
	c.form_name = ""
	c.form_abbr = ""
	c.form_street = ""
	c.form_city = ""
	c.form_state = ""

	c.form_duns = ""
